details.description: Moonshot-v1-128k was the largest-context model in Moonshot AI's original moonshot-v1 chat series (alongside moonshot-v1-8k and moonshot-v1-32k), offering a 128,000-token context window through an OpenAI-compatible chat completions API. Moonshot AI's current platform documentation states the moonshot-v1 series was officially discontinued on August 31, 2026 and is no longer maintained or supported, with users directed to Kimi K3 instead.
advantages: Offered the largest context window (128,000 tokens) of the three original moonshot-v1 tiers (8k, 32k and 128k), per Moonshot AI's model list.
disadvantages: Officially discontinued on August 31, 2026 and no longer maintained or supported, per Moonshot AI's current platform documentation.
Moonshot AI directs users to migrate to the newer Kimi K3 model for continued support.
use_cases: Was used for general-purpose long-context chat completion via Moonshot AI's OpenAI-compatible API

notes: Moonshot AI has removed moonshot-v1-128k's own docs/model-card page since discontinuing it, so no maker page describes its original feature set beyond context length; website_url left null. Catalog facts list no deprecation_date, but Moonshot AI's model list page explicitly states the whole moonshot-v1 series (including this model) was discontinued 2026-08-31, which is worth reflecting in the catalog's deprecation_date.
